"""RoboWits seal_colander trajectory controller, limited-mode client."""
from rcb_client import Robot
from pathlib import Path
import json, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

OUT = Path('/app/output')
RUNS = OUT / 'runs'
RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def save_obs(obs, name):
    d = RUNS / name
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (d/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(d/f'{cam}.png')
    for cam, depth in getattr(obs, 'last_depth', {}).items():
        np.save(d/f'{cam}_depth.npy', depth)
    return d

def pose_action(right_xyz=None, left_xyz=None, right_q=None, left_q=None,
                right_grip=None, left_grip=None, duration_s=2.0, video='mp4'):
    """Move selected TCP targets while holding the other arm at its measured pose."""
    o = robot.get_obs()
    n = np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    rp = n[16:23].copy(); lp = n[23:30].copy()
    if right_xyz is not None: rp[:3] = right_xyz
    if left_xyz is not None: lp[:3] = left_xyz
    if right_q is not None: rp[3:7] = right_q
    if left_q is not None: lp[3:7] = left_q
    rg = float(n[7] if right_grip is None else right_grip)
    lg = float(n[15] if left_grip is None else left_grip)
    target = np.r_[rp, rg, lp, lg]
    result = robot.submit('ee_pose', target, video=video, depth=True,
                          note='cautious TCP waypoint')
    result.save(str(RUNS / f'cmd_{len(list(RUNS.glob("cmd_*"))):02d}'))
    return result

if __name__ == '__main__':
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True)
    save_obs(obs, 'before')
    n = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    # The staging point is high above the table, on the approach side of the
    # central vessel. Preserve the observed tool orientation and keep fingers open.
    target = np.r_[[.48, -.12, 1.00], n[19:23], .09,
                   n[23:30], .09]
    result = robot.submit('ee_pose', target, video='mp4', depth=True,
                          note='high right-arm observation waypoint')
    result.save(str(RUNS/'stage_right'))
    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True)
    save_obs(obs, 'after_stage')
    print(json.dumps({'done': result.meta.get('done'), 'reason': result.meta.get('reason'),
                      'plan': result.meta.get('plan'), 'time_left_s': obs.meta.get('time_left_s'),
                      'tcp': obs.meta['proprio']['now'][16:30]}, default=float))
